Maya R: Quick scheduling — we need a facilitator for the postmortem of this morning's ~2h paging incident. Customer readout required. Proposed slots: Thu 3:30–4:00pm PT or Fri 10:00–10:30am PT. Who can facilitate and who must attend?
Incident Bot: Incident #4121 post-incident review requested. Suggested owners: eng-oncall, platform, cs-account. See incident summary: https://incidents.redwood/4121
Samir K: I can facilitate Thu 3:30. Would prefer Thu so we can send customer pre-read today.
Jess T: I have an overlapping customer call at 3pm PT — can't do Thu. Fri 10 works for me. I'll be on the customer readout on Fri.
Luis A: I'm +1 for Thu as backup facilitator. Need the action list exported to Jira beforehand.
Olivia C: I'm required for the customer readout. I can do Fri only (timezone: CET). Fri 10 PT = Fri 7pm CET for me — ok.
Maya R: Noted. If Thu gets more votes, Samir primary, Luis backup. If Fri wins, Jess primary, Maya backup. Can everyone add availability reaction: :one: for Thu, :two: for Fri.
Samir K: :one:
Luis A: :one:
Jess T: :two:
Olivia C: :two:
Maya R: Cool. Looks tied 2-2. Customer readout wants earlier turnaround — leaning Thu. Jess is required for readout but can't do Thu. Two options: (1) do Thu with Samir facilitating and ask Jess to join asynchronously or (2) move to Fri for full readout.
Olivia C: Prefer real-time attendance for readout, so vote Fri from my side.
Maya R: OK — final call: we'll do Fri 10 PT to include Jess and Olivia. Samir — can you be backup facilitator? Luis — can you create the pre-read snapshot and export action template to JIRA by EOD?
Samir K: Yep, I'll be backup and stand by to run meeting if Jess can't.
Luis A: Will post pre-read doc and Jira template by 6pm PT. Link: https://docs.redwood/pre-reads/4121
Maya R: I'll create calendar invite and include customer readout slot. Invite link: https://calendar.redwood/event/4121-pir
Maya R: quick timezone table:
```
Fri 10:00 PT = Fri 13:00 ET = Fri 18:00 GMT+1 (CET)
```
Maya R: tagging attendees to block time: @Jess T @Olivia C @Samir K @Luis A — please accept invite or flag conflicts.
Jess T: Accepted. I'll prepare the customer slides.
Olivia C: Accepted.
Incident Bot: Reminder scheduled — 24h before and 30m before. If we need to change, reply here.
Maya R: Thanks everyone — closing this thread once calendar confirmed.
